name: Intrinsic Decomposition of 3D Gaussian Splats
aliases: Intrinsic Decomposition with Separate Gaussian Fields
definition: A method to decompose a radiance field represented as 3D Gaussian splats into three independent sets of Gaussian primitives: albedo (G_A), shading (G_S), and view-dependent residual (G_R), allowing for multi-view consistent editing of object textures without altering lighting.
summary: Intrinsic Decomposition of 3D Gaussian Splats separates radiance fields into distinct albedo, shading, and residual Gaussian sets to enable multi-view consistent texture editing without altering lighting.
